FC-DMS10 Series Smart Electronic Sentinel

Sensor: Back-illuminated Starlight-grade CMOS
Rotation Range: 360° Continuous Pan; -90° to +90° Tilt
Applications: Rapid tactical deployment for border and military camps; integrated 'Detection & Deterrent' frontline defense; all-weather 24/7 surveillance in high-wind environments; mobile sentry and temporary site security.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC-DMS10 series intelligent electronic sentinel is a lightweight, multi-functional, multi-purpose, and intelligent optical detection device integrating various sensors, control modules, pointing devices, and intelligent algorithms. It can achieve functions such as reconnaissance and surveillance, situational awareness, and security early warning.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Key Features

  • Multi-spectral complementary advantages, meeting the working requirements under day and night and all-weather conditions.
  • Supports intelligent functions such as hotspot alarm, target detection, tracking, and device PHM health management.
  • Integrated design of detection and warning, integrating detection module and warning module.
  • Quasi-spherical structure design, better wind resistance and anti-shake performance, clearer imaging.
  • Flexible deployment, simple operation, stable and reliable, easy to maintain.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Visible Light1. Sensor: Back-illuminated ultra-low illumination starlight-grade CMOS 2. Resolution: 1920×1080 3. Illumination: Color: 0.0005Lux; B/W: 0.0001Lux; 0Lux (IR ON) 4. Lens Focal Length: 7mm～300mm/7mm～330mm 47x optical zoom 16x digital zoom 5. Focus Control: Manual/Auto focus
Thermal Radiation Lens (Optional)1. Detector: 6th generation uncooled focal plane array VOx detector 2. Resolution: 640×512/384×288 3. NETD: 40mK (@25℃ F1.0) 4. Lens Focal Length: 50mm/75mm/100mm fixed focus 5. Strong Light Protection: Supports anti-sunlight damage
Illumination1. Laser Type: HD floodlight homogenized light source 2. Illumination Angle: 3°～65° 3. Illumination Distance: 300 meters 1. Laser Type: HD floodlight homogenized light source 2. Illumination Angle: 1°～20° 3. Illumination Distance: 1000 meters Sound and Light Warning: Built-in integrated tweeter + strobe light, supports custom alarm sound and laser dazzling warning
PTZ1. Rotation Speed: Horizontal: 0.01°/s～100°/s; Tilt: 0.01°/s～80°/s 2. Rotation Range: Horizontal: 360° continuous rotation; Tilt: -90°～+90° 3. Presets: 3000
Interfaces1. Power Supply Interface: 1-ch DC12V～36V 2. Communication Interface: 1-ch RJ45 Ethernet port (supports optional 4G/5G transmission)
Power Consumption1. Peak Power Consumption: ≤60W
Dimensions1. Weight: ≤10kg (including load) 2. Dimensions: 312mm×200mm×298mm (L×W×H)
Environmental Adaptability1. Working Temperature: -40℃～60℃ 2. Working Humidity: ≤95% RH 3. Protection Level: IP67
Customization1. Supports customized function development
